notes.title: Preview of upcoming changes.
notes.notes:
I'm currently working on a larger update that will focus on new mechanics not related to the main vehicle in the game. 

These will include a building system and the ability to share buildings with other users via the Steam Workshop.. Unfortunately, I cannot yet give a specific date for the update to come out. I can only promise that it will be the biggest update that has come out so far.



Thank you for your patience. Sorry for lack of updates since february, but I want to release polished mechanics.


Couple screenshots from "work in progress" version (sorry for polish subtitles, translations are not finished yet):

notes.title: Critical bugfixes, build 02-01-2025
notes.notes:
Adjustments to game physics. Following bugs should not occur any more:
- screws stopped working,
- cleaning stopped working,
- measure stopped working,
- welding stopped working,
- angle gridner stopped working,
- dog did not bite,
- junk delivery stopped working

Additionally translations to radio has been added, can be toggled on in "general" options.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
In couple of minutes build number "19-12-2024-2" wil be deployed. Bug fixes:
- SAM guidebook in corner of the gagrage should work properly now. If your SAM in your save is missing engine, transmision or steering mechanism then missing parts will be added when building new one in SAM guidebook menu
- "flip nearest vehicle" in "I'm stuck" tab has been fixed and will not affect vehicles in maintanance mode
- because of "flip nearest vehicle" bug Tow Service is temporarly free. Tow Service is located next to junkyard, in rounded building
- gym notes on the wall has been fixed

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
In couple of minutes build number "19-12-2024" wil be deployed. Bug fixes:
- painting back doors of Odra is now possible
- angle griner disc shoud decrease on cutting
- disappearing empty jar fixed
- air filter in OHV should wear slower
- electrode refill should be eaasier now (collider size increased)
- car jack should have normal weight, instead of 500kg
- UI fixes in english version
- SAM guidebook which is awailable in corner of garage should work as intended now, you can disassemby current SAM and start new one
- fix for wrong tooltip on rear diff refill
